description: Tool to search for tickets, users, organizations, and groups in Zendesk using query syntax. Use when you need to find resources across Zendesk using flexible search criteria.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for searching Zendesk resources.

include.description: Sideloads to include in the response, returned as top-level arrays alongside `results`. Zendesk's search endpoint requires nested syntax: `<result_type>(<resource1>,<resource2>)`. Combine multiple result types with commas. Common sideloads: `users`, `groups`, `organizations`. A flat comma list (e.g. 'users,groups') is silently ignored by Zendesk.
include.title: Include

per_page.description: Number of results per page. Default: 10, max: 100.
per_page.title: Per Page

query.description: The search query string. Supports Zendesk query syntax for filtering by type, status, priority, etc. Example: 'type:ticket status:open priority:urgent' or 'assignee:me status:pending'.
query.title: Query

sort_by.description: Field to sort results by. Options: 'updated_at', 'created_at', 'priority', 'status', 'ticket_type'. Defaults to sorting by relevance if not specified.
sort_by.title: Sort By

sort_order.description: Sort order direction. Options: 'asc' (ascending) or 'desc' (descending). Defaults to 'desc' if not specified.
sort_order.title: Sort Order

inputSchema.title: SearchZendeskRequest

name: search_zendesk

SearchResult.description: A search result object from Zendesk.

default.description: Whether this is a default object (for group results)
default.title: Default

external_id.description: External ID linking to records in another system
external_id.title: External Id

id.description: The ID of the result object
id.title: Id

organization_id.description: Organization ID associated with the result
organization_id.title: Organization Id

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp in ISO 8601 format
updated_at.title: Updated At

url.description: API URL for the result object
url.title: Url

SearchResult.title: SearchResult

SearchZendeskResponse.description: Response from Zendesk search API with results and pagination.

count.description: The number of resources returned in this page of results
count.title: Count

facets.description: Facets corresponding to the search query
facets.title: Facets

next_page.description: URL for the next page of results
next_page.title: Next Page

previous_page.description: URL for the previous page of results
previous_page.title: Previous Page

results.description: Array of search results (tickets, users, organizations, groups)
results.title: Results

SearchZendeskResponse.title: SearchZendeskResponse
